thread:
maya_support: Heads up — a customer (org id: org_91f) just reported their Token Cost dashboard shows $0 for last 7 days and NaN in the hourly sparklines. Happening for a subset of their subaccounts. Screenshot attached in ticket: https://redwood.example/t/3201 (redacted).

lee_eng: Thanks Maya — can you paste repro steps + the org IDs? Do we know if this started after the rollup job at 02:00 UTC? :eyes:

maya_support: Repro steps from the customer: 1) Login to console -> Billing -> Token cost tile 2) Select org 91f and timeframe last 7d 3) Some subaccounts show $0 and NaN. They said it looks fine in raw usage CSV. Started ~2026-03-16 02:10 UTC after weekly rollup. Org list: org_91f, suborg_91f-a, suborg_91f-b.

sara_billing: cc @lee_eng — initial guess: priced token join failed in rollup for these subaccounts (price lookup returned null). Can someone run quick check on the priced_tokens table for those orgs?

mike_data: Running a quick SQL to check priced_tokens ingestion: ```sql
SELECT org_id, suborg_id, priced_amount, price_lookup_key, ingest_ts
FROM priced_tokens
WHERE org_id IN ('org_91f')
  AND ingest_ts > '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z'
ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

deploy-bot: Job run: weekly-rollup-v2 started at 2026-03-16T02:00:12Z, duration 00:07:08, worker=rollup-5, status=SUCCESS (but warnings: price-lookup: 17 nulls).

lee_eng: That matches — rollup logged price-lookup warnings. I suspect a mismatch between price_catalog v3 and legacy model keys for those subaccounts. If priced_amount is null we render $0 or NaN downstream.

maya_support: Customer confirms raw usage CSV shows tokens and model names. They said they updated one subaccount's model alias around the same time (could explain lookup miss).

mike_data: Quick data dump shows priced_amount is null for suborg_91f-b for rows between 2026-03-09 and 2026-03-16. suborg_91f-a has some rows with priced_amount=0.0 and others NULL.

lee_eng: Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) Run backfill price-lookup for affected ingest window (2026-03-09 -> 2026-03-16) for org_91f only. 2) Mark tile to show "partial data" instead of $0 while backfill in progress. 3) Investigate cause of price_catalog mismatch (deploy/config drift).

ana_support: Customer asked for ETA on fix and whether they'll be charged incorrectly.

sara_billing: If priced_amount is null we don't bill — but we also shouldn't show $0 as authoritative. We should show "incomplete data" and force a re-run of pricing. I'll open an urgent backfill BackfillRequest and flag Billing Ops.

mike_data: Backfill SQL to recompute priced_amount (sanitized): ```sql
-- recompute priced_amount using price_catalog_v3
INSERT INTO priced_tokens_backfill (org_id, suborg_id, ts, priced_amount)
SELECT u.org_id, u.suborg_id, u.ts,
  COALESCE(pc.price_per_token * u.token_count, 0) AS priced_amount
FROM raw_tokens u
LEFT JOIN price_catalog_v3 pc
  ON u.model_key = pc.model_key
WHERE u.org_id = 'org_91f'
  AND u.ts BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-16';
```

lee_eng: I'll run the backfill on a staging preview first to confirm no double-billing risk, then schedule production backfill with rate limit. Expect ~30min for preview and ~2h for prod for that org.

maya_support: Customer updated ticket saying they can wait for the backfill but asked for a temporary dashboard note. Can we add a UI banner?

lee_eng: Ana from product can you push a temporary banner for affected orgs showing: "Some cost data is incomplete for the selected timeframe due to a backlog in pricing. We're recomputing — expected resolution in ~2 hours." We can target by org_id until backfill completes.

ana_support: I added the customer note to the ticket and included the org ids.

deploy-bot: BackfillPreview/job-987 created at 2026-03-16T14:10:04Z by lee_eng (preview); estimated rows 12,432.

mike_data: Preview looks good — priced_amount populated for sample rows, no duplicates. Ready for prod run.

lee_eng: Prod backfill scheduled at 2026-03-16T15:00Z. I'll post when finished.

sara_billing: Billing Ops notified to watch for any late charges and confirm reconciliation after backfill.

deploy-bot: Backfill/job-987 completed at 2026-03-16T15:18:22Z, status=SUCCESS, rows_updated=12432.

mike_data: Verified dashboard now shows non-zero costs for org_91f and both suborgs. Sparklines restored, NaN gone. Ran a spot-check against raw CSV: priced totals match expected within rounding.

maya_support: Customer notified and they confirmed UI looks correct now. Closing ticket in 24h if no regressions. Thanks all :tada:

lee_eng: Follow-ups: 1) Root cause: price_catalog v3 deploy missed alias mapping for renamed model aliases — add a deploy-step to re-run alias sync. 2) Add monitoring alert if rollup emits >5 price-lookup nulls for any org in a single run. I'll file tickets.

sara_billing: Filing billing postmortem and SLA note.

ana_support: Marking thread resolved from support side.
